sources.author: Morphed PL
patch_list: Blocks the Żabka CDP event pipeline (device, root, network and carrier data attached to every event), Sentry, AppsFlyer, Synerise event tracking, Firebase Analytics, Facebook app events and Google datatransport uploads.

Replaces the app's Google Maps API key. The original key is locked to the developer's signing certificate, so maps stay grey in a re-signed app. Use a key you own that allows the app's package name and the SHA-1 of the key the patched app…
Reports Żabka's original signing certificate to Firebase, so login works after the app is re-signed by patching.
